words.example_en: Many people like to shop for new clothes during seasonal sales.

words.example_en: She wants to buy a warm winter coat before the cold weather starts.

words.example_en: Customers can purchase items online and pick them up in the store.
words.example_tr: Müşteriler ürünleri internetten satın alıp mağazadan teslim alabilirler.

words.example_en: Shoppers usually prefer to pay with credit cards instead of cash.
words.example_tr: Alışveriş yapanlar genellikle nakit yerine kredi kartıyla ödeme yapmayı tercih eder.

words.example_en: Teenagers often spend their pocket money on trendy fashion items.
words.example_tr: Gençler genellikle harçlıklarını trend moda ürünlerine harcarlar.

words.example_en: Customers like to browse through clothing racks before making a choice.

words.example_en: Shoppers can select different sizes and colors from the display screen.

words.example_en: Always try on trousers in the fitting room before you buy them.

words.example_en: Bright red colors really suit your skin tone and hair color.
words.example_tr: Canlı kırmızı renkler ten rengine ve saç rengine gerçekten çok yakışıyor.

words.example_en: She knows how to match her shoes with her handbag.
words.example_tr: Ayakkabılarını el çantasıyla nasıl uyumlu hale getireceğini (uyduracağını) biliyor.

words.example_en: Business people usually wear formal suits and ties to the office.
words.example_tr: İş insanları genellikle ofise resmi takım elbise ve kravat giyer.

words.example_en: Put on your warm jacket before you step out into the cold street.

words.example_en: Please take off your muddy shoes before entering the house.
words.example_tr: Eve girmeden önce lütfen çamurlu ayakkabılarınızı çıkarın.

words.example_en: I need to go home and change into comfortable clothes.

words.example_en: If the shirt does not fit, you can return it within thirty days.
words.example_tr: Gömleğin bedeni uymazsa, otuz gün içinde iade edebilirsiniz.

words.example_en: She wants to exchange this medium-size sweater for a large one.
words.example_tr: Bu orta boy kazakla büyük boy olanı değiştirmek istiyor.

words.example_en: The cashier will refund your money if you show the purchase receipt.
words.example_tr: Satın alma fişini gösterirseniz kasiyer paranızı iade edecektir.

words.example_en: You can order clothes online and have them delivered to your home.
words.example_tr: Kıyafetleri internetten sipariş edebilir ve evinize teslim edilmesini sağlayabilirsiniz.

words.example_en: Courier companies deliver online shopping packages within two days.
words.example_tr: Kurye şirketleri çevrimiçi alışveriş paketlerini iki gün içinde teslim eder.

words.example_en: Shop assistants carefully pack fragile items in gift boxes.

words.example_en: Could you please wrap this perfume bottle in shiny red paper?

words.example_en: The store assistant can recommend trousers that fit your body type.

words.example_en: Fashion experts advise wearing comfortable shoes for long walking tours.

words.example_en: That leather jacket makes you look very cool and modern.

words.example_en: This summer dress seems a little too short for formal occasions.
words.example_tr: Bu yazlık elbise resmi durumlar için biraz fazla kısa gibi görünüyor.

words.example_en: Many shoppers prefer cotton fabrics because they are soft and breathable.
words.example_tr: Birçok alışverişçi pamuklu kumaşları tercih eder çünkü yumuşak ve nefes alabilirdir.

words.example_en: People stop to admire the beautiful window displays in fashion streets.

words.example_en: Famous Italian tailors design exclusive clothes for celebrities.

words.example_en: Large textile factories manufacture thousands of shirts every week.

words.example_en: Eco-friendly brands produce clothes using organic cotton and recycled materials.

words.example_en: Companies label clothing items with washing instructions and sizes.

words.example_en: Stores display their newest fashion collections right in the front window.

words.example_en: Smart consumers compare prices online before buying expensive gadgets or clothes.
words.example_tr: Akıllı tüketiciler pahalı cihazlar veya kıyafetler satın almadan önce fiyatları internette karşılaştırır.

words.example_en: It takes her a while to decide which dress to buy for the party.
words.example_tr: Parti için hangi elbiseyi alacağına karar vermesi biraz zaman alıyor.

words.example_en: Do not hesitate to ask shop assistants if you need a different size.

words.example_en: People should not waste money on clothes they will never wear.
words.example_tr: İnsanlar asla giymeyecekleri kıyafetlere para israf etmemelidir.

words.example_en: She likes to collect vintage fashion accessories from old markets.
words.example_tr: Eski pazarlardan nostaljik (vintage) moda aksesuarları toplamayı sever.

words.example_en: Customers need to sign the receipt when paying with certain credit cards.
words.example_tr: Müşteriler belirli kredi kartlarıyla ödeme yaparken fişi imzalamalıdır.

words.example_en: Shoppers have to queue at the cash desk during weekend sales.
words.example_tr: Alışveriş yapanlar hafta sonu indirimlerinde kasa masasında sırada beklemek zorunda kalıyor.

words.example_en: Clothing brands advertise their new styles on social media platforms.

words.example_en: Famous models promote seasonal fashion trends in glossy magazines.

words.example_en: Social media trends heavily influence what young people wear today.
words.example_tr: Sosyal medya trendleri günümüzde gençlerin ne giydiğini büyük ölçüde etkiliyor.

words.example_en: Bright yellow coats help people stand out in a crowd.
words.example_tr: Parlak sarı montlar insanların kalabalıkta öne çıkmasına (dikkat çekmesine) yardımcı olur.

words.example_en: Some people prefer to wear dark colors so they can blend in.
words.example_tr: Bazı insanlar göze batmamak (ortama uyum sağlamak) için koyu renkler giymeyi tercih eder.
